title: Energy meter secured BLE transport (service A003, Lite/Pro)

authMaterial.pin: 8 digits 0-9 from the meter body (the 11 digits under the QR code decode to it; protocol only knows the 8-digit PIN)

steps.3: channel up on THIS GATT connection

flow: step 0: PBKDF2 + EC J-PAKE round1/round2 -> LTK, session_key (step becomes 3)
step 2: ble-crypto-session-nonce with cached LTK (step becomes 3)
step 3 with no local session: disconnect and reconnect; never repeat J-PAKE on the same connection
send business JSON as encrypted envelope {nonce,ct,tag}; strictly serial
LTK is persisted by the device only after Wi-Fi STA association succeeds in the same encrypted session

kdf.pbkdf2: HMAC-SHA256, password=PIN ascii, salt=SN||ver||'PBKDF2', 10000 iterations, 32 bytes
kdf.jpake: secp256r1, SHA-256, identities 'client'/'server', round payloads Base64
kdf.ccmNonceBase: HKDF salt=empty L=8; device->client info 'ccm-tx-nonce' (IKM device_nonce||client_nonce); client->device info 'ccm-rx-nonce' (IKM client_nonce||device_nonce)

envelope.nonce: uint32 counter; 12-byte CCM nonce = 8-byte HKDF base || BE32(counter); client->device must strictly increase

doNot: use plaintext service A002 / C303 / C304 / C305
change curve, iteration count or HKDF info strings
log full LTK / session_key / broadcast_key by default
